title: Kennedy Center lawsuit reignites to fight adding Trump’s name – twice
shortDescription: After the Kennedy Center board voted to add Trump's name back onto the facade, opponents again asked a judge to block the move.

title: Democrat's Senate map improves as Texas, Iowa shift to toss-up
shortDescription: A nonpartisan election forecast for control of the U.S. Senate moves away from Republicans in two states President Donald Trump won decisively in 2024

title: Texas Senate, governor races tighten as Cook Report shifts ratings
shortDescription: The Cook Political Report and Fox News now label the Texas Senate race a toss up amid tight polling numbers. The governor's race is tightening too.

title: Navy may name new carrier for Trump instead of WWII Hero, Doris Miller
shortDescription: The Navy may name a new aircraft carrier after President Donald Trump instead of World War II sailor Doris Miller.

title: Trump tries to push Darline Graham to victory with South Carolina trip
shortDescription: President Trump is visiting South Carolina on Friday to give a final boost to Sen. Darline Graham before the state's Republican primary runoff.

title: Navy may name new aircraft carrier after Trump and not WWII hero
shortDescription: The move to name an aircraft carrier after a sitting president would mark an unprecedented move. The carrier was expected to be named in honor of Doris Miller.

title: Debate grows over paid access to Trump's posts

title: Trump vows ‘economic warfare' against Iran
shortDescription: President Donald Trump announced “Economic Warfare and Isolation on an unprecedented scale” against Iran, as well as countries that aid Iran.

title: El-Sayed and Rogers tied in new MI Senate poll, GOP lead in 50+ voters
shortDescription: A new AARP poll shows Michigan voters at-large prefer Democrats Abdul El-Sayed and Jocelyn Benson, but the 50+ voter group preferred the GOP.

title: Michael Cohen interviews Trump in shock 'reconciliation'

title: Trump's approval rating remains stagnant. What new polling shows
